title: Pair duplication computation
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, the constructed machine computes the encoding of the pair $(x,x)$—the string obtained by doubling each bit of $x$, then appending the separator $01$ and a further copy of $x$—in exactly $4(|x|+1)$ steps.
